theorem normalizedProfile_variation_le {Phi : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hPhi : ContDiff ℝ 1 Phi) {M D U A H ell u v : ℝ}
    (hM0 : 0 ≤ M) (hD0 : 0 ≤ D)
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2, |Phi x| ≤ M)
    (hD : ∀ x ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2, |deriv Phi x| ≤ D)
    (hU : 0 < U) (hA : 0 < A) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hlo : U ≤ u) (huv : u ≤ v) (hhi : v ≤ 2*U)
    (hfloor : ell ≤ Real.log (A*U)) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖normalizedProfile Phi t U A H v‖ +
      (∫ y in Ioc u v, ‖deriv (normalizedProfile Phi t U A H) y‖) ≤
      |H|⁻¹ * ((M+D)/ell+M/ell^2)*(1+|t|)

scope.coefficient: physicalProfile Phi t U y / (H * log(A*y))
scope.A: Product of the other occurrences of the same original HB group
scope.H: Product of logs of other original groups; arbitrary real H, including totalized zero
scope.bound: norm F(v) + integral_(u,v] norm F'(y) <= abs(H)^(-1) * ((M+D)/ell + M/ell^2) * (1+abs(t))
scope.assumptions: Phi real C1; M,D >= 0 and bounds of Phi and real derivative on [1,2]; U,A,ell > 0; U<=u<=v<=2U; ell<=log(A*U)
